title: Lip-sync synchrony indicator: weak or unclear
summary: Mouth movement and speech loudness show only a weak or unclear relationship (best lag -0.30 s, correlation 0.19, peak prominence 0.28). The indicator is not yet calibrated: its thresholds did not separate genuine from swapped-audio clips, so every result is reported as inconclusive. Lowest-agreement segments are marked for human review.

details.rule_reason: no clear audio-mouth correlation peak near zero lag

evidence.label: Mouth movement vs speech loudness series

alternatives: Dubbing or translation can replace the original audio track
Bluetooth or other playback/recording audio delay can shift sound against the picture
A low or variable frame rate blurs the timing of mouth movement
A small face in frame gives a noisy mouth measurement
The person speaking may be off-screen, or another voice may be louder than the visible speaker
limitations: Calibrated on only 5 genuine clips and 5 audio-swapped controls; the two groups did not separate cleanly
Mouth movement and speech loudness are only loosely related; this is a synchrony indicator, not a verdict
Lip-sync is reported as inconclusive until recalibration (LIPSYNC_ALLOW_CONTRADICTION is off)
